query: The Pink Beauty Spa, Hialeah, FL
name: The Pink Beauty Spa

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alessandra Monti
reviewSamples.text: This is the best spa ever!!! I’ve been coming to the pink beauty spa for years now and they never disappointed me!! I’ve done my eyebrows and my lips and I keep getting compliments about them!! Facials are also sooo good!! And Norma, the owner, she is literally the best! So sweet and so welcoming <3
